observed_limit: Eight visible pose cues show heel-leading placement, loaded support, trailing heel/foot lift and controlled bow. They are not a labeled biomechanical cycle; exact passing crossings and opposite-leg identities are authored, not asserted from the strip.
phase_assignment: Use observed contact/lift/upper-body cues; infer true near/far alternation and key timing in the native rig. Never copy frames as sprites.
head: Stabilize with small torso counter-rotation
bow: Controlled grip, no broad pendulum swing
